---
title: "Automated Biological Function Categorization"
subtitle: "Keyword-based assignment of GO terms to function categories"
params:
  top_n: 1000
---

## Overview

Applies automated keyword-based regex matching to assign biological function categories to condition-specific GO terms from the upstream pipeline output.

## Load packages

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| message: false

pacman::p_load(writexl, install = FALSE)

conflicted::conflict_prefer_all("dplyr", quiet = TRUE)
```

## Source the categorization function

```{r}
#| label: source-function

source(here("custom_func/assign_biofunc_category.R"))
```

## Load data

Read the CSV file containing condition-specific GO terms.

```{r}
#| label: load-data

go_terms <- read_csv(
  here(glue("pathway_analysis/03_transition_specific_GO_terms/output/top{params$top_n}_condition_specific_GO_terms.csv")),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

glue("top{params$top_n}: {nrow(go_terms)} rows")
```

## Apply automated categorization

```{r}
#| label: apply-categorization

go_terms_cat <- go_terms |>
  mutate(function_category = assign_biofunc_category(Description))
```

## Save automated categorizations

```{r}
#| label: save-excel

fs::dir_create(here("pathway_analysis/04_function_categorization/output"))

write_xlsx(
  go_terms_cat,
  here(glue("pathway_analysis/04_function_categorization/output/top{params$top_n}_condition_specific_GO_terms_auto_cat.xlsx"))
)

glue("Saved top{params$top_n} automated categorizations to output/")
```

## Summary

### Check for uncategorized terms

```{r}
#| label: check-na

na_count <- sum(is.na(go_terms_cat$function_category))

glue("Uncategorized terms: {na_count} out of {nrow(go_terms_cat)} ({scales::percent(na_count / nrow(go_terms_cat), accuracy = 0.1)})")
```

```{r}
#| label: show-na-terms

if (na_count > 0) {
  go_terms_cat |>
    filter(is.na(function_category)) |>
    distinct(Description) |>
    knitr::kable(caption = "Uncategorized descriptions")
}
```

### Category counts per condition

```{r}
#| label: category-counts

go_terms_cat |>
  count(condition, function_category) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = condition, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
  arrange(function_category) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = glue("Category counts for top{params$top_n}"))
```
